import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
cells=[x.r.values for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[]
for b in range(4000):
  m=[rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for v in cells]; bs.append(np.mean(np.array(m[1::2])-np.array(m[0::2])))
print('strat',np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('hi+med',est(w[w.date_confidence!='low']))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean().round(3).to_dict())
print('1850-1900',est(w[(w.year>=1850)&(w.year<1900)]))
print('excl other',est(w[w.genre!='other']))
print(w.author_key.nunique(), w.groupby('author_key').size().max())
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
m=smf.ols('r~late*C(genre)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params.filter(like='late').round(3))
print(p[p.work_id.isin(w[w[c]>0].work_id)].passage_id.head(8).tolist())
"
